scientific_integrity: Finite direct-order checks supplement, and do not replace, full analytic derivations. Literature access gaps documented without negative-coverage claims.
scientific_limitations: Irreversible, one-attempt, tie-free dimer dynamics on finite homogeneous cycles; two designated disjoint bonds forced earliest. Signed factorial screening holds after fixed-separation thermodynamic limit. One-bond law holds only for terminal counts. Classical homogeneous finite-line means credited to prior work; novelty assessment nonexhaustive and independent validation absent.
title: Two-seed parity reversal and factorial screening in one-dimensional dimer adsorption
